pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with jagged, serrated pixel-level edge gradients. Individual dark regions exhibit internal pigment density variation, appearing darker at the geometric centers.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming tri-radiate and tetra-radiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible lateral field.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal ridge, representing the 1D contour of the mane against the background.
